## History

Cooper was a local villager who witnessed [Walter](../character/walter.md) riding pigs through the streets after [Faith](../character/faith.md) dared him to do so. Following the stunt, Cooper was among the townspeople who reacted to the spectacle as the news spread through the community.

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P0](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0000), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P1](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0001), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P2](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0002), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P3](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0003), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P5](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0005), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P6](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0006), +38 more_
